# Context

**Artemis and Image Safari** (Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT) are open collections of millions of crop photographs on Amazon Web Services (licence CC BY-SA 4.0, no account needed). Here we **look inside**, **download 10 photographs** and **open them** with `pliman`. The full explanation is in the tutorial linked from the slides (`tutorial-artemis-photos.html`).

> **Work in pairs and download only 10 photographs per pair.** We share the wifi of the room.

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("xml2", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("xml2")
library(xml2)
library(pliman)
```

# Two helper functions

```{r functions}
base <- "https://alliance-artemis-imagesafari.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"

# List one "folder" of the bucket: returns the sub-folders and the files (key, size in MB)
list_bucket <- function(prefix = "", max_keys = 200) {
  url <- paste0(base, "/?list-type=2&delimiter=%2F&max-keys=", max_keys,
                "&prefix=", utils::URLencode(prefix, reserved = TRUE))
  x <- xml2::read_xml(url)
  xml2::xml_ns_strip(x)
  list(
    folders = xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(x, "//CommonPrefixes/Prefix")),
    files   = data.frame(
      key     = xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(x, "//Contents/Key")),
      size_mb = round(as.numeric(xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(x, "//Contents/Size"))) / 1e6, 2)
    )
  )
}

# Download one file by its key into a local folder
get_photo <- function(key, dest = "artemis_photos") {
  dir.create(dest, showWarnings = FALSE)
  out <- file.path(dest, basename(key))
  utils::download.file(paste0(base, "/", utils::URLencode(key)), out, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  out
}
```

# Look inside the collection

```{r top}
# You should see two folders: Artemis/ and ImageSafari/
list_bucket("")$folders
```

```{r down}
# HINT: write one of the folders that you saw above, ending with /
prefix <- "___"                          # TODO: start with "Artemis/", then go down one folder at a time
cur <- list_bucket(prefix)
cur$folders
head(cur$files, 10)
```

Repeat the box above with a deeper folder until you find files that end in `.jpg` or `.jpeg`.

# Download 10 photographs

```{r download}
photos <- subset(cur$files, grepl("\\.jpe?g$", key, ignore.case = TRUE) & size_mb < 6)
nrow(photos)
sel <- head(photos$key, ___)             # TODO: how many photographs? 10 is enough
paths <- vapply(sel, get_photo, character(1))
paths
```

# Look at them in R

```{r look}
img <- image_import(paths[1])
dim(img)
plot(img)
```

```{r indices, fig.height = 3}
image_index(img, index = c("R", "GLI", "NGRDI"), ncol = 3, nrow = 1)
```

**Your findings:** is the background uniform? Is the light even? Which index separates the plant from the soil best? What would you change in the way the photograph is taken? _...write here..._
